base_url.label: Server URL
base_url.description: The address of your Gotify server, e.g. https://gotify.example.com. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

app_token.label: App Token
app_token.description: Token of a Gotify application. Used to send notifications.

client_token.label: Client Token
client_token.description: Token of a Gotify client. Needed to read or delete messages and manage applications.

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Get the Gotify user of the Client Token.
